title: Gibson Superior Sound Tee, Vintage Blue, Exclusive

long_description.body:
This heavyweight, garment-dye vintage blue-colored tee is made from 6.1 oz ringspun cotton and features a Superior Sound graphic screen printed on the front.



100% Ringspun cotton
Unisex sizing, relaxed fit
Wash with cold water, no bleach. Tumble dry low. Do not iron or dry clean
